title: Fast Privacy Loss Accounting for Random Allocation via Multiscale FFT
abstract: arXiv:2610.42117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the random allocation sampling scheme each user's data is used in $k$ steps chosen randomly and uniformly from a sequence of $t$ steps. This scheme is known to improve on Poisson sampling in private optimization and in communication-efficient aggregation. The existing privacy loss distribution (PLD) accountant for this scheme runs in time quadratic in the inverse of the accuracy parameter $\alpha$ (Feldman and Shenfeld, 2026). We give an algorithm, \emph{multiscale FFT}, that represents likelihood ratios on a grid that is uniform within each dyadic interval and computes the exact rounding of every pairwise sum using FFTs within each interval. It keeps the guarantees of the accountant and improves the dependence of its running time on $\alpha$ from $O(\alpha^{-2})$ to $O(\alpha^{-1}\log(1/\alpha))$. translated_title: 基于多尺度FFT的随机分配隐私损失快速核算
translated_abstract: 在随机分配采样方案中，每个用户的数据被用于从 $t$ 个步骤组成的序列中随机且均匀选出的 $k$ 个步骤。该方案已知在隐私优化和通信高效聚合中优于泊松采样。现有的针对该方案的隐私损失分布（PLD）核算器的运行时间是精度参数 $\alpha$ 的倒数的平方（Feldman 和 Shenfeld，2026）。我们提出了一种名为“多尺度FFT”的算法，该算法在每个二进制（dyadic）区间内均匀的网格上表示似然比，并在每个区间内使用FFT计算每个成对和的精确舍入。该算法保持了原有核算器的保证，并将其运行时间对 $\alpha$ 的依赖性从 $O(\alpha^{-2})$ 改进到 $O(\alpha^{-1}\log(1/\alpha))$。此外，我们证明了舍入操作可以通过（Doroshenko 等人，2026 年的）保均值连线投影来执行。
tldr: 该论文提出多尺度FFT算法，在每个二进制区间内均匀网格上表示似然比并用区间内FFT计算精确舍入，将随机分配采样方案的隐私损失核算运行时间从 $O(\alpha^{-2})$ 改进到 $O(\alpha^{-1}\log(1/\alpha))$，同时保持原有隐私保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multiscale FFT algorithm that represents likelihood ratios on grids uniform within each dyadic interval and computes exact roundings via per-interval FFTs, improving the privacy loss accounting runtime for the random allocation scheme from $O(\alpha^{-2})$ to $O(\alpha^{-1}\log(1/\alpha))$ while preserving the original privacy guarantees.
